schema.name: geobc_geometry_bc_cloud22_v1
schema.index_meaning: Zero-based row in canonical prepared xyz/features; original FEM-node ordering, never deck nodeID minus1
schema.channels: Existing sampled canonical xyz3 then original25 slots0:7 and13:25 (non-force19)
schema.mask: Existing unchanged bool1024; masked index=-1 and nonforce padding=0
schema.scope: Existing TRAIN40 + development-validation5 canonical ver inputs only
schema.role_semantics: Six support-reference DOF membership roles plus load-interface membership; not node Dirichlet conditions or field GT
schema.identity: Exact FP32 coordinate identity with coincident-row ambiguity rejection; original sampler replay allowed only for missing exact matches and only with exact canonical xyz/cloud/mask verification

API.request_contract: request_contract(plan_path=DEFAULT_PLAN)->(contract,plan), pure stdlib JSON/source SHA/file stat; source check accepts pending BC cache
API.prepare_data: prepare_data(plan_path=DEFAULT_PLAN)->completed manifest, root only after training_rules_frozen and final source pins
API.read_cache_metadata: read_cache_metadata(plan_path=DEFAULT_PLAN,*,contract=None)->completed manifest; strict contract/output stat without array reads
API.load_bc_cloud: load_bc_cloud(manifest.records[cad],device)->dict cloud float32[1,1024,22],mask bool[1,1024]; trainer overrides only old case cloud/mask, not query/targets/scaler

identity_design.verified_old_source: conditioned_field.GeometryCloud has node_indices but solver_selection_data.prepare_data writes xyz/cloud/mask only; points are copied directly from the same prepared FP32 xyz rows without secondary normalization
identity_design.primary: np.unique sorted exact FP32 rows -> searchsorted sampled rows; reject any sampled coordinate with multiple original row matches even if features agree; preserve sampled point order
identity_design.fallback: Only missing exact matches may replay original canonical NPZ xyz/faces/key, blake2b CADseed2026, unique boundary rows and default_rng.choice without replacement. Require original canonical xyz, reproduced cloud/mask and sampling metadata exact equality; reject discrepancy, never nearest/tolerance/ID arithmetic
identity_design.masked_padding: Reuse original mask; indices=-1/nonforce padding0 only for already masked slots
identity_design.role_coverage: Seven source binary flags, source/sample counts, sampled fractions and represented/missing CADs; descriptive only, no resampling or node Dirichlet claim

author_receipt.metadata_module_import: Own stdlib-only data module; no scientific imports

release_conditions: Root freezes the paired plan and final data/sampling/helper source identities
One actual target-free45CAD preparation; any coordinate ambiguity or source/mask mismatch fails without repair
Both solver arms use the same completed BC22 manifest, unchanged known3 targets/TRAIN-only scaler and original query nodes
output: data/geobc_geometry_bc_clouds/{cad}/indices.npy and cloud_bc22.npy plus small completed manifest/status/config; original mask path reused; no old cache/grid rebuilt
